'''Geral''' is a [[Malkier]]i soldier.

== Activities ==
Geral fights at [[Tarwin's Gap]] with [[Lan Mandragoran]], and the uncrowned King of Malkier grows to respect him.{{ref/book|14|28}}

== Trivia ==
* Geral is named for Gerald Turkington, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
